description:
Crewser 24" BMX Bike – Now with V-Brakes for Better Wheelie Control
You asked, we delivered. The Crewser 24" now comes equipped with V-brakes—a major upgrade from old-school U-brakes. That means stronger stopping power, smoother modulation, and way more control when you're balancing on one wheel.
Built to Wheelie. Ready to Ride.
Whether you're dialing in combos or just learning balance point, the Crewser’s geometry and V-brake setup give you the confidence to hold it up and keep it there.
• 24” wheels for smooth rollouts and effortless momentum
• High-strength Steel frame, fork and handlebar to deliver durability, control, and confidence on any ride
• Chromoly three-piece cranks to push power into every pedal stroke
• Double-wall rims built to take abuse
• Fully sealed bearings for a quiet, buttery ride that lasts
Control the Streets
The Crewser 24" isn’t just built to ride—it’s built to perform. Cruise your block, hit your line, drop into traffic, or mob deep with your crew. Wherever you ride, this bike brings the heat
Better brakes. Cleaner wheelies. Bigger rides.
This is your bike for going all in.
Ride up. Ride smooth. Ride Crewser.
